  1. solvers.dataStructures

Uses of Class
solvers.dataStructures.PopulationVector

Packages that use PopulationVector
Package
Description
solvers.dataStructures
Data structures shared by the JMVA solvers (tuples, positions, lists and matrices).
solvers.linearSystem
Linear system formulation shared by the MoM and CoMoM exact algorithms of JMVA.
solvers.linearSystem.btf
Block Triangular Form (BTF) of the linear systems arising in the MoM and CoMoM algorithms, as described in the method of moments literature.
solvers.linearSystem.simple
Simple linear system solvers used by JMVA.
solvers.queueingnet
Queueing network model of JMVA: stations, classes, service demands and visits used by the exact and approximate solution algorithms.
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms
Tree based exact algorithms of JMVA: TreeMVA and TreeConvolution, which reduce the complexity of the exact solution of large closed models.
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.tmva
TreeMVA algorithm of JMVA, the tree based version of the exact Mean Value Analysis.
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.treeConvolution
TreeConvolution algorithm of JMVA, the tree based version of the convolution algorithm.
